Title: chrisgliddon/bevy-skills

signals.title: Ryan-Clinton/telescopeyoke
signals.content: A self-measuring robotic observatory for affordable GoTo mounts, Sky-Watcher SynScan first, run by a person and an AI agent: whole nights, self-calibration, nova and comet searches, transit photometry, alerts by phone and house, a live science broadcast. AI proposes; code decides what is safe; a person authorises moves.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: Ryan‑Clinton/telescopeyoke
A low‑cost, self‑measuring robotic observatory that upgrades affordable GoTo mounts (initially Sky‑Watcher SynScan). The system combines a human operator with an AI agent that plans nightly activities, performs self‑calibration, and conducts automated searches for novae, comets, and transit photometry. Alerts are sent to the operator’s phone and home network, and a live science broadcast streams observations. The AI proposes actions, safety‑critical code validates them, and the human authorises any mount movements.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: Ryan‑Clinton/telescopeyoke
مرصد روبوتي ذاتي القياس منخفض التكلفة يطوّر حوامل GoTo الاقتصادية (بدءًا بـ Sky‑Watcher SynScan). يجمع النظام بين مشغل بشري ووكيل ذكاء اصطناعي يخطط للأنشطة الليلية، يجرى المعايرة الذاتية، ويقوم ببحث آلي عن السدم الجديدة والمذنبات وتصوير العبور الضوئي. تُرسل التنبيهات إلى هاتف المشغل وشبكة المنزل، وتُبث ملاحظات علمية مباشرة. يقترح الذكاء الاصطناعي الإجراءات، يتحقق الكود من سلامتها، ويُصرّح المشغل بحركة الحامل.

signals.title: GoSync-Inc/deedkit
signals.content: Self-hosted Telegram and WhatsApp archive for AI agents. MCP, HTTP API, search and files by GoSync.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: GoSync-Inc/deedkit

Brief: GoSync-Inc/deedkit is an open‑source, self‑hosted solution that archives Telegram and WhatsApp communications for AI agents. It provides a multi‑channel processor (MCP), an HTTP API, and full‑text search capabilities, allowing agents to retrieve messages and attached files programmatically. The platform is designed for on‑premise deployment, giving operators control over data storage and privacy. Current public information confirms the core features, but details on performance, scalability, and security hardening remain limited.

العنوان: GoSync-Inc/deedkit

الملخص: GoSync-Inc/deedkit هو حل مفتوح المصدر يُستضاف ذاتيًا لأرشفة محادثات Telegram وWhatsApp لاستخدامها من قبل وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي. يوفّر معالجًا متعدد القنوات (MCP)، وواجهة برمجة تطبيقات HTTP، وإمكانية البحث النصي الكامل، مما يمكّن الوكلاء من استرجاع الرسائل والملفات المرفقة برمجياً. يُصمم النظام للتنصيب داخل البنية التحتية للمؤسسة، ما يمنح المشغلين سيطرة على تخزين البيانات وخصوصيتها. المعلومات المتاحة تؤكد وجود الميزات الأساسية، لكن تفاصيل الأداء، القابلية للتوسع، وتعزيزات الأمان لا تزال غير واضحة.

signals.title: @AnthropicAI: New Anthropic research: progress on provable inference for large language models. Here, we introduce FlashProve. Building on established cry
signals.content: New Anthropic research: progress on provable inference for large language models. Here, we introduce FlashProve. Building on established cryptographic techniques, FlashProve allows developers to verify whether a given response came from a given AI model. It’s substantially more efficient than prior open-source methods for doing so. These proofs have a range of applications. They can, for instance, make it harder for attackers to hijack a chat, or enable safety evaluators to verify that the model they’re testing is the same one being served to customers. For our full write-up, see here: https://t.co/OIZWPb6QZa Further progress in provable inference will likely be an important part of improving trust in AI deployment. To that end, we're open-sourcing FlashProve’s code, here: https://t.co/7ky3Ir8V06 We’re grateful to our collaborators: Alessandro Chiesa, @GiacomoFenzi, @gwberg95, @miranda__christ, Rahul Dalal (https://t.co/pjWKLHWXyz) and Ben Mayer (@transmissions11).

signals.title: @OpenAI: As AI becomes more capable at finding vulnerabilities, defenders need to put it to work before attackers do. We’re planning our next interna
signals.content: As AI becomes more capable at finding vulnerabilities, defenders need to put it to work before attackers do. We’re planning our next internal security sprint at OpenAI and partnering with Cathedral Systems, whose researchers will use our models alongside our teams to challenge our defenses. They’ll bring differentiated expertise and approaches to our ongoing work to find and fix weaknesses with AI. We’re also raising bug bounty rewards, including more than quadrupling rewards for critical findings. Exceptional findings will be eligible for up to $172,000, including bonuses. We’ll keep advancing our models, using them to strengthen our own systems, and expanding access for trusted defenders. https://t.co/vcaoHROTt2
